title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. How might this affect the bias of the model?

title: Effect of LASSO on Model Bias
text: Consider how reducing the complexity of a model by setting some coefficients to zero might affect the model's bias. What is a possible effect on model bias squared when using LASSO regularization?
